workflow: A stateful serialization operation begins and retains internal buffers or bookkeeping for its active work.
During user-controlled callback execution, the callback re-enters the same stateful object through another operation.
The re-entrant operation clears, replaces, or reinitializes shared internal state while the outer operation still depends on it.
The outer operation resumes with stale assumptions and accesses invalidated state, causing use-after-free, corruption, or process termination instead of rejecting the re-entrant or
summary: Reentrant use invalidates active state during serialization
decision_reason: The causal mechanism materially matches reentrant callback activity invalidating a backing resource or shared state before the outer operation reuses it; the serialization-specific objects and APIs are incidental.
